name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Zoho's collaboration and messaging app, with REST APIs, bots and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 with Bearer scheme sent as Authorization header prefixed Zoho-oauthtoken; access tokens are valid for 1 hour and are refreshed with a refresh token. Use the domain-specific accounts URL for your data center.
access_notes: Apps are registered self-serve in the Zoho API console (accounts.zoho.com/developerconsole). Pricing and whether API access depends on plan tier are not stated in the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve OAuth app registration and a documented REST API, but pricing and whether API access depends on plan tier are not stated in the fetched pages.

identity.quote: Check out our archive of REST APIs, explained with syntax and sample code.

auth.quote: Zoho's OAuth implementation uses the Bearer authentication scheme

access.quote: The first step in using OAuth authentication is registering your app with the Zoho API console.

api_surface.quote: Cliq API is standardized around REST, allowing you to perform read and write operations that you do with our web client.
v3 standardizes this with only next_token for paging and sync_token for incremental synchronization across all modules.

mcp.quote: The Cliq MCP Server exposes Cliq's core capabilities as standardized tools

needs_human_reason: Pricing, plan-tier gating of API access, sandbox availability, endpoint count and the MCP server endpoint URL are not stated in the fetched pages. The MCP url is left null because only the product page was cached.
